ayahs.textUthmani: الٓمٓ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: الٓمٓ ۝١
ayahs.translation: Alif, Lām, Meem.[113]
ayahs.transliteration: Alif-Laam-Meeem
ayahs.translationClear: Alif, Lam, Meem.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ۝٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اللّٰهُ لَا͏ٓ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَۙ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّوْمُ ؕ

words.translation: the Sustainer of all that exists

ayahs.translation: Allāh - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining.[114]
ayahs.transliteration: Allaahu laaa ilaaha illaa Huwal Haiyul Qaiyoom
ayahs.translationClear: Allah, there is no god but He, the Living, the Eternal.

ayahs.textUthmani: نَزَّلَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَأَنزَلَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: نَزَّلَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَأَنزَلَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ ۝٣
ayahs.textIndopak: نَزَّلَ عَلَيْكَ الْكِتٰبَ بِالْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَاَنْزَلَ التَّوْرٰىةَ وَالْاِنْجِيْلَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: He has sent down upon you, [O Muḥammad], the Book in truth, confirming what was before it. And He revealed the Torah and the Gospel
ayahs.transliteration: Nazzala 'alaikal Kitaaba bilhaqqi musaddiqal limaa baina yadaihi wa-anzalat Tawraata wal-Injeel
ayahs.translationClear: He sent down to you the Book with the truth, confirming what came before it; and He sent down the Torah and the Gospel.

ayahs.textUthmani: مِن قَبْلُ هُدًى لِّلنَّاسِ وَأَنزَلَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مِن قَبْلُ هُدًى لِّلنَّاسِ وَأَنزَلَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ‌ۗ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ‌ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٍ ۝٤
ayahs.textIndopak: مِنْ قَبْلُ هُدًي لِّلنَّاسِ وَاَنْزَلَ الْفُرْقَانَ࣢ؕ اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيْدٌؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَزِيْزٌ ذُو انْتِقَامٍ
ayahs.translation: Before, as guidance for the people. And He revealed the Criterion [i.e., the Qur’ān]. Indeed, those who disbelieve in the verses of Allāh will have a severe punishment, and Allāh is Exalted in Might, the Owner of Retribution.[115]
ayahs.transliteration: Min qablu hudal linnaasi wa-anzalal Furqaan:(a) innal latheena kafaroo bi-Aayaatil laahi lahum 'athaabun shadeed:(unw) wallaahu 'azeezun thun tiqaam

footnotes.115: i.e., He who restores justice by punishing those who persist in wrongdoing, fail to heed warnings and are unrepentant.

ayahs.translationClear: Aforetime, as guidance for mankind; and He sent down the Criterion. Those who have rejected Allah’s signs will have a severe punishment. Allah is Mighty, Able to take revenge.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَيْهِ شَىْءٌ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَيْهِ شَىْءٌ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ ۝٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَخْفٰي عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْاَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَا࢜ءِ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, from Allāh nothing is hidden in the earth nor in the heaven.
ayahs.transliteration: Innal laaha laa yakhfaa 'alaihi shai'un fil ardi wa-laa fis samaaa'
ayahs.translationClear: Nothing is hidden from Allah, on earth or in the heaven.

ayahs.textUthmani: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُصَوِّرُكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْحَامِ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ ۚ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُصَوِّرُكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْحَامِ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ‌ۚ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ۝٦
ayahs.textIndopak: هُوَ الَّذِيْ يُصَوِّرُكُمْ فِي الْاَرْحَامِ كَيْفَ يَشَا࢜ءُؕ لَا͏ٓ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ
ayahs.translation: It is He who forms you in the wombs however He wills. There is no deity except Him, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: Huwal lathee yusawwi-rukum fil arhaami kaifa yashaaa,('oo) laa ilaaha illaa Huwal 'Azeezul Hakeem
ayahs.translationClear: It is He who forms you in the wombs as He wills. There is no god except He, the Almighty, the Wise.

ayahs.textUthmani: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِنْهُ ءَايَـٰتٌ مُّحْكَمَـٰتٌ هُنَّ أُمُّ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَأُخَرُ مُتَشَـٰبِهَـٰتٌ ۖ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ زَيْغٌ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ مَا تَشَـٰبَهَ مِنْهُ ٱبْتِغَآءَ ٱلْفِتْنَةِ وَٱبْتِغَآءَ تَأْوِيلِهِۦ ۗ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ تَأْوِيلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَٱلرَّٰسِخُونَ فِى ٱلْعِلْمِ يَقُولُونَ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ كُلٌّ مِّنْ عِندِ رَبِّنَا ۗ وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ إِلَّآ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِنْهُ ءَايَـٰتٌ مُّحْكَمَـٰتٌ هُنَّ أُمُّ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَأُخَرُ مُتَشَـٰبِهَـٰتٌ‌ۖ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ زَيْغٌ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ مَا تَشَـٰبَهَ مِنْهُ ٱبْتِغَآءَ ٱلْفِتْنَةِ وَٱبْتِغَآءَ تَأْوِيلِهِۦ‌ۗ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ تَأْوِيلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ‌ۗ وَٱلرَّٰسِخُونَ فِى ٱلْعِلْمِ يَقُولُونَ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ كُلٌّ مِّنْ عِندِ رَبِّنَا‌ۗ وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ إِلَّآ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ ۝٧
ayahs.textIndopak: هُوَ الَّذِيْٓ اَنْزَلَ عَلَيْكَ الْكِتٰبَ مِنْهُ اٰيٰتٌ مُّحْكَمٰتٌ هُنَّ اُمُّ الْكِتٰبِ وَاُخَرُ مُتَشٰبِهٰتٌؕ فَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ فِيْ قُلُوْبِهِمْ زَيْغٌ فَيَتَّبِعُوْنَ مَا تَشَابَهَ مِنْهُ ابْتِغَا࢜ءَ الْفِتْنَةِ وَابْتِغَا࢜ءَ تَاْوِيْلِهٖۚؔ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ تَاْوِيْلَهٗٓ اِلَّا اللّٰهُۘؔ وَالرّٰسِخُوْنَ فِي الْعِلْمِ يَقُوْلُوْنَ اٰمَنَّا بِهٖۙ كُلٌّ مِّنْ عِنْدِ رَبِّنَاۚ وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ اِلَّا͏ٓ اُولُوا الْاَلْبَابِ
ayahs.translation: It is He who has sent down to you, [O Muḥammad], the Book; in it are verses [that are] precise - they are the foundation of the Book - and others unspecific.[116] As for those in whose hearts is deviation [from truth], they will follow that of it which is unspecific, seeking discord and seeking an interpretation [suitable to them]. And no one knows its [true] interpretation except Allāh. But those firm in knowledge say, "We believe in it. All [of it] is from our Lord." And no one will be reminded except those of understanding,
ayahs.transliteration: Huwal latheee anzala 'alaikal Kitaaba minhu Aayaatum Muh-kamaatun hunna Ummul Kitaabi wa-ukharu Muta-shaabihaat(un); fa-ammal latheena fee quloobihim zaiyghun fa-yattabi'oona ma tashaa-baha minhub tighaaa 'alfitnati wabtighaaa'a ta`weelih:(i) wa-maa ya'lamu ta`wee-lahooo illal laah:(u) war-raasi-khoona fil 'ilmi yaqooloona aamannaa bihee kullum min 'indi Rabbinaa: wa-maa yaththakkaru illaaa ulul albaab

footnotes.116: Those which are stated in such a way that they are open to more than one interpretation or whose meaning is known only to Allāh, such as the opening letters of certain sūrahs.

ayahs.translationClear: It is He who revealed to you the Book. Some of its verses are definitive; they are the foundation of the Book, and others are unspecific. As for those in whose hearts is deviation, they follow the unspecific part, seeking dissent, and seeking to derive an interpretation. But none knows its interpretation except Allah and those firmly rooted in knowledge say, “We believe in it; all is from our Lord.” But none recollects except those with understanding.

ayahs.textUthmani: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً‌ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ ۝٨
ayahs.textIndopak: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوْبَنَا بَعْدَ اِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ رَحْمَةًۚ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
ayahs.translation: [Who say], "Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.[117]
ayahs.transliteration: Rabbanaa laa tuzigh quloobanaa ba'da ith hadaitanaa wa-hab lanaa mil ladunka rahmah,(tan) innaka antal Wahhaab

footnotes.117: Who gives and grants continually without being asked.

ayahs.translationClear: “Our Lord, do not cause our hearts to swerve after You have guided us, and bestow on us mercy from Your presence; You are the Giver.”

ayahs.textUthmani: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ ٱلنَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ ٱلنَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ‌ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ ۝٩
ayahs.textIndopak: رَبَّنَا͏ٓ اِنَّكَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيْهِؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ الْمِيْعَادَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allāh does not fail in His promise."
ayahs.transliteration: Rabbanaaa innaka jaami 'un-naasi li-Yawmil laa raiba feeh,(i) innal laaha laa yukhliful mee'aad
ayahs.translationClear: “Our Lord, You will gather the people for a Day in which there is no doubt.” Allah will never break His promise.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَن تُغْنِىَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَٰلُهُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَـٰدُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ وَقُودُ ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَن تُغْنِىَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَٰلُهُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَـٰدُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا‌ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ وَقُودُ ٱلنَّارِ ۝١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا لَنْ تُغْنِيَ عَنْهُمْ اَمْوَالُهُمْ وَلَا͏ٓ اَوْلَادُهُمْ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ شَيْـٔ͏ًاؕ وَاُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ هُمْ وَقُوْدُ النَّارِ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who disbelieve - never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allāh at all. And it is they who are fuel for the Fire.
ayahs.transliteration: Innal latheena kafaroo lan tughniya 'anhum am-waaluhum wa-laaa aw-laaduhum minal laahi shai'a(nw); wa-ulaaa'ika hum waqoodun Naar
ayahs.translationClear: As for those who disbelieve, neither their wealth nor their children will avail them anything against Allah. These will be fuel for the Fire.

ayahs.textUthmani: كَدَأْبِ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَدَأْبِ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ‌ۚ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ‌ۗ وَٱللَّهُ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ ۝١١
ayahs.textIndopak: كَدَاْبِ اٰلِ فِرْعَوْنَۙ وَالَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْؕ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَاۚ فَاَخَذَهُمُ اللّٰهُ بِذُنُوْبِهِمْؕ وَاللّٰهُ شَدِيْدُ الْعِقَابِ
ayahs.translation: [Theirs is] like the custom of the people of Pharaoh and those before them. They denied Our signs, so Allāh seized them for their sins. And Allāh is severe in penalty.
ayahs.transliteration: Kada`abi Aali Fir'awna wallatheena min qablihim, kaththaboo bi-Aayaatinaa fa-akhatha-humul laahu bi-thunoo-bihim: wallaahu shadeedul 'iqaab
ayahs.translationClear: Like the behavior of Pharaoh’s people and those before them. They rejected Our signs, so Allah seized them for their sins. Allah is Strict in retribution.

ayahs.textUthmani: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ سَتُغْلَبُونَ وَتُحْشَرُونَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ سَتُغْلَبُونَ وَتُحْشَرُونَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ‌ۚ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ ۝١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ لِّلَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا سَتُغْلَبُوْنَ وَتُحْشَرُوْنَ اِلٰي جَهَنَّمَؕ وَبِي͏ٔ͏ْسَ الْمِهَادُ
ayahs.translation: Say to those who disbelieve, "You will be overcome and gathered together to Hell, and wretched is the resting place."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul lillatheena kafaroo satugh-laboona wa-tuh`sharoona ilaa jahannam,(a) wa-bi'sal mihaad
ayahs.translationClear: Say to those who disbelieve, “You will be defeated, and rounded up into Hell—an awful resting-place.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ ءَايَةٌ فِى فِئَتَيْنِ ٱلْتَقَتَا ۖ فِئَةٌ تُقَـٰتِلُ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَأُخْرَىٰ كَافِرَةٌ يَرَوْنَهُم مِّثْلَيْهِمْ رَأْىَ ٱلْعَيْنِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُؤَيِّدُ بِنَصْرِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ ءَايَةٌ فِى فِئَتَيْنِ ٱلْتَقَتَا‌ۖ فِئَةٌ تُقَـٰتِلُ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَأُخْرَىٰ كَافِرَةٌ يَرَوْنَهُم مِّثْلَيْهِمْ رَأْىَ ٱلْعَيْنِ‌ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُؤَيِّدُ بِنَصْرِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ‌ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ ۝١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: قَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ اٰيَةٌ فِيْ فِي͏ٔ͏َتَيْنِ الْتَقَتَاؕ فِي͏ٔ͏َةٌ تُقَاتِلُ فِيْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ وَاُخْرٰي كَافِرَةٌ يَّرَوْنَهُمْ مِّثْلَيْهِمْ رَاْيَ الْعَيْنِؕ وَاللّٰهُ يُو͏ٔ͏َيِّدُ بِنَصْرِهٖ مَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّاُولِي الْاَبْصَارِ
ayahs.translation: Already there has been for you a sign in the two armies which met [in combat at Badr] - one fighting in the cause of Allāh and another of disbelievers. They saw them [to be] twice their [own] number by [their] eyesight.[118] But Allāh supports with His victory whom He wills. Indeed in that is a lesson for those of vision.
ayahs.transliteration: Qad kaana lakum Aayatun fee fi'atainil taqat(aa); fi'atun tuqaatilu fee sabeelil laahi wa-ukhraa kaafiratuien yaraw`nahum mis`laihim ra`ayal 'ayn,(i) wallaahu yu'ayyidu bi-nasrihee maien yashaaa':(u) innaa fee thaalika la-'ibratal li-ulil absaar

footnotes.118: The believers saw the disbelievers to be double their own number preceding the battle of Badr, while, in fact, they were three times their number.

ayahs.translationClear: There was a sign for you in the two parties that met. One party fighting in the way of Allah, and the other was disbelieving. They saw them with their own eyes twice their number. But Allah supports with His help whomever He wills. In that is a lesson for those with insight.

ayahs.textUthmani: زُيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ حُبُّ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ مِنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ وَٱلْبَنِينَ وَٱلْقَنَـٰطِيرِ ٱلْمُقَنطَرَةِ مِنَ ٱلذَّهَبِ وَٱلْفِضَّةِ وَٱلْخَيْلِ ٱلْمُسَوَّمَةِ وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ وَٱلْحَرْثِ ۗ ذَٰلِكَ مَتَـٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥ حُسْنُ ٱلْمَـَٔابِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: زُيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ حُبُّ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ مِنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ وَٱلْبَنِينَ وَٱلْقَنَـٰطِيرِ ٱلْمُقَنطَرَةِ مِنَ ٱلذَّهَبِ وَٱلْفِضَّةِ وَٱلْخَيْلِ ٱلْمُسَوَّمَةِ وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ وَٱلْحَرْثِ‌ۗ ذَٰلِكَ مَتَـٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا‌ۖ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥ حُسْنُ ٱلْمَـَٔابِ ۝١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: زُيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ حُبُّ الشَّهَوٰتِ مِنَ النِّسَا࢜ءِ وَالْبَنِيْنَ وَالْقَنَاطِيْرِ الْمُقَنْطَرَةِ مِنَ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ وَالْخَيْلِ الْمُسَوَّمَةِ وَالْاَنْعَامِ وَالْحَرْثِؕ ذٰلِكَ مَتَاعُ الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَاۚ وَاللّٰهُ عِنْدَهٗ حُسْنُ الْمَاٰبِ
ayahs.translation: Beautified for people is the love of that which they desire - of women and sons, heaped-up sums of gold and silver, fine branded horses, and cattle and tilled land. That is the enjoyment of worldly life, but Allāh has with Him the best return [i.e., Paradise].
ayahs.transliteration: Zuyyina linnaasi hubbush shahawaati minan nisaaa'i wal-baneena wal-qanaa-teeril muqan-tarati minaz thahabi wal-fiddati wal-khailil musaw-wamati wal-an'aami walhars:(i) thaalika mataa'ul hayaatid dunyaa; wallaahu 'indahoo husnul ma-aab
ayahs.translationClear: Adorned for the people is the love of desires, such as women, and children, and piles upon piles of gold and silver, and branded horses, and livestock, and fields. These are the conveniences of the worldly life, but with Allah lies the finest resort.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ قُلْ أَؤُنَبِّئُكُم بِخَيْرٍ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمْ ۚ لِلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَأَزْوَٰجٌ مُّطَهَّرَةٌ وَرِضْوَٰنٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ قُلْ أَؤُنَبِّئُكُم بِخَيْرٍ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمْ‌ۚ لِلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَأَزْوَٰجٌ مُّطَهَّرَةٌ وَرِضْوَٰنٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ‌ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ ۝١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ اَو͏ٔ͏ُنَبِّي͏ٔ͏ُكُمْ بِخَيْرٍ مِّنْ ذٰلِكُمْؕ لِلَّذِيْنَ اتَّقَوْا عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنّٰتٌ تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا وَاَزْوَاجٌ مُّطَهَّرَةٌ وَّرِضْوَانٌ مِّنَ اللّٰهِؕ وَاللّٰهُ بَصِيْرٌۢ بِالْعِبَادِ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Say, "Shall I inform you of [something] better than that? For those who fear Allāh will be gardens in the presence of their Lord beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally, and purified spouses and approval from Allāh. And Allāh is Seeing [i.e., aware] of [His] servants -
ayahs.transliteration: ^Qul a'unabbi-'ukum bikhairim min thaalikum, lil-latheenat taqaw 'inda Rabbihim jannaatun tajree min tah-tihal anhaaru khaalideena feehaa wa-azwaajum mutah-haratunw wa-ridwaanum minal laah:(i) wallaahu baseerum bil'ibaad
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “Shall I inform you of something better than that? For those who are righteous, with their Lord are Gardens beneath which rivers flow, where they will remain forever, and purified spouses, and acceptance from Allah.” Allah is Observant of the servants.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ۝١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلَّذِيْنَ يَقُوْلُوْنَ رَبَّنَا͏ٓ اِنَّنَا͏ٓ اٰمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوْبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Those who say, 'Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire,' "
ayahs.transliteration: Allatheena yaqooloona Rabbanaaa innanaaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa thunoobanaa wa-qinaa 'athaaban Naar
ayahs.translationClear: Those who say, “Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us our sins, and save us from the suffering of the Fire.”

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ وَٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ وَٱلْقَـٰنِتِينَ وَٱلْمُنفِقِينَ وَٱلْمُسْتَغْفِرِينَ بِٱلْأَسْحَارِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ وَٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ وَٱلْقَـٰنِتِينَ وَٱلْمُنفِقِينَ وَٱلْمُسْتَغْفِرِينَ بِٱلْأَسْحَارِ ۝١٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلصّٰبِرِيْنَ وَالصّٰدِقِيْنَ وَالْقٰنِتِيْنَ وَالْمُنْفِقِيْنَ وَالْمُسْتَغْفِرِيْنَ بِالْاَسْحَارِ
ayahs.translation: The patient, the true, the obedient, those who spend [in the way of Allāh], and those who seek forgiveness before dawn.
ayahs.transliteration: Assaabireena wassaa-diqeena walqaaniteena walmunfiqeena walmus-taghfireena bil-as-haar
ayahs.translationClear: The patient, and the truthful, and the reverent, and the charitable, and the seekers of forgiveness at dawn.

ayahs.textUthmani: شَهِدَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمِ قَآئِمًۢا بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۚ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: شَهِدَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمِ قَآئِمًۢا بِٱلْقِسْطِ‌ۚ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: شَهِدَ اللّٰهُ اَنَّهٗ لَا͏ٓ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَۙ وَالْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةُ وَاُولُوا الْعِلْمِ قَا࢜ىِٕمًاۢ بِالْقِسْطِؕ لَا͏ٓ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Allāh witnesses that there is no deity except Him, and [so do] the angels and those of knowledge - [that He is] maintaining [creation] in justice. There is no deity except Him, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: Shahidal laahu annahoo laa ilaaha illaa Huwa wal-malaaa'ikatu wa-ulul 'ilmi qaaa'imam bilqist; laaa ilaaha illaa Huwal 'Azeezul Hakeem
ayahs.translationClear: Allah bears witness that there is no god but He, as do the angels, and those endowed with knowledge—upholding justice. There is no god but He, the Mighty, the Wise.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْإِسْلَـٰمُ ۗ وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۗ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْإِسْلَـٰمُ‌ۗ وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ‌ۗ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ ۝١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ الدِّيْنَ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ الْاِسْلَامُࣞ وَمَا اخْتَلَفَ الَّذِيْنَ اُوْتُوا الْكِتٰبَ اِلَّا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَا࢜ءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْيًاۢ بَيْنَهُمْؕ وَمَنْ يَّكْفُرْ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَرِيْعُ الْحِسَابِ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the religion in the sight of Allāh is Islām. And those who were given the Scripture did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And whoever disbelieves in the verses of Allāh, then indeed, Allāh is swift in [taking] account.
ayahs.transliteration: Innad deena 'indal laahil Islaam;(u) wamakh talafal latheena ootul Kitaaba illaa mim ba'di maa jaaa'ahumul 'ilmu baghyam bainahum: wa-mai yakfur bi-Aayaatil laahi fa-innal laaha saree'ul hisaab
ayahs.translationClear: Religion with Allah is Islam. Those to whom the Scripture was given differed only after knowledge came to them, out of envy among themselves. Whoever rejects the signs of Allah—Allah is quick to take account.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَإِنْ حَآجُّوكَ فَقُلْ أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّهِ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَنِ ۗ وَقُل لِّلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْأُمِّيِّـۧنَ ءَأَسْلَمْتُمْ ۚ فَإِنْ أَسْلَمُوا۟ فَقَدِ ٱهْتَدَوا۟ ۖ وَّإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَإِنْ حَآجُّوكَ فَقُلْ أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّهِ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَنِ‌ۗ وَقُل لِّلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْأُمِّيِّـۧنَ ءَأَسْلَمْتُمْ‌ۚ فَإِنْ أَسْلَمُوا۟ فَقَدِ ٱهْتَدَوا۟‌ۖ وَّإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ‌ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ ۝٢٠
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاِنْ حَا࢜جُّوْكَ فَقُلْ اَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلّٰهِ وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَنِؕ وَقُلْ لِّلَّذِيْنَ اُوْتُوا الْكِتٰبَ وَالْاُمِّيّٖنَ ءَاَسْلَمْتُمْؕ فَاِنْ اَسْلَمُوْا فَقَدِ اهْتَدَوْاۚ وَاِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَاِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ الْبَلٰغُؕ وَاللّٰهُ بَصِيْرٌۢ بِالْعِبَادِ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: So if they argue with you, say, "I have submitted myself to Allāh [in Islām], and [so have] those who follow me." And say to those who were given the Scripture and [to] the unlearned,[119] "Have you submitted yourselves?" And if they submit [in Islām], they are rightly guided; but if they turn away - then upon you is only the [duty of] notification. And Allāh is Seeing of [His] servants.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa-in haaaj-jooka faqul aslamtu wajhiya lillaahi wa-manit taba'an:(i) wa-qul lillatheena ootul Kitaaba wal-ummiyyeena 'a-aslamtum, fa-in aslamoo faqadih tadaw; wa-in tawallaw fa-innamaa 'alaikal balaagh:(u) wallaahu baseerum bil-'ibaad

footnotes.119: Those who had no scripture (i.e., the pagans).

ayahs.translationClear: If they argue with you, say, “I have surrendered myself to Allah, and those who follow me.” And say to those who were given the Scripture, and to the unlearned, “Have you surrendered?” If they have surrendered, then they are guided; but if they turn away, then your duty is to convey. Allah is Seeing of the servants.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ وَيَقْتُلُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ وَيَقْتُلُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ ۝٢١
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يَكْفُرُوْنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَيَقْتُلُوْنَ النَّبِيّٖنَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّۙ وَّيَقْتُلُوْنَ الَّذِيْنَ يَاْمُرُوْنَ بِالْقِسْطِ مِنَ النَّاسِۙ فَبَشِّرْهُمْ بِعَذَابٍ اَلِيْمٍ
ayahs.translation: Those who disbelieve in the signs of Allāh and kill the prophets without right and kill those who order justice from among the people - give them tidings of a painful punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: Innal latheena yakfuroona bi-Aayaatil laahi wa-yaqtuloonan Nabiyyeena bighairi haqqinw wa-yaqtuloonal latheena yaa`muroona bilqisti minan naasi fabash-shirhum bi'athaabin aleem
ayahs.translationClear: As for those who defy Allah’s revelations, and kill the prophets unjustly, and kill those who advocate justice among the people—promise them a painful retribution.

ayahs.textUthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَـٰلُهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَـٰلُهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ ۝٢٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ الَّذِيْنَ حَبِطَتْ اَعْمَالُهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِؗ وَمَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ نّٰصِرِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: They are the ones whose deeds have become worthless in this world and the Hereafter, and for them there will be no helpers.
ayahs.transliteration: Ulaaa'ikal latheena habitat a'maaluhum fid dunyaa wal-Aaakhirah(ti) wa-maa lahum min naasireen
ayahs.translationClear: They are those whose deeds will come to nothing, in this world and in the Hereafter; and they will have no saviors.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ نَصِيبًا مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَىٰ كِتَـٰبِ ٱللَّهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّىٰ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُمْ وَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ نَصِيبًا مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَىٰ كِتَـٰبِ ٱللَّهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّىٰ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُمْ وَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ ۝٢٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلَمْ تَرَ اِلَي الَّذِيْنَ اُوْتُوْا نَصِيْبًا مِّنَ الْكِتٰبِ يُدْعَوْنَ اِلٰي كِتٰبِ اللّٰهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَلّٰي فَرِيْقٌ مِّنْهُمْ وَهُمْ مُّعْرِضُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Do you not consider, [O Muḥammad], those who were given a portion of the Scripture? They are invited to the Scripture of Allāh that it should arbitrate between them;[120] then a party of them turns away, and they are refusing.
ayahs.transliteration: Alam tara ilal latheena ootoo naseebam minal Kitaabi yud'awna ilaa Kitaabil laahi liyah-kuma bai-nahum summa yata-wallaa fareequm minhum wa-hum mu'ridoon

footnotes.120: Referring to the Jews of Madīnah who refused to implement the rulings given by Allāh in the Torah or to acknowledge the Prophet (ﷺ), whose coming was mentioned therein.

ayahs.translationClear: Have you not considered those who were given a share of the Scripture, as they were called to the Scripture of Allah to arbitrate between them; then some of them turned back, and declined?

ayahs.textUthmani: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لَن تَمَسَّنَا ٱلنَّارُ إِلَّآ أَيَّامًا مَّعْدُودَٰتٍ ۖ وَغَرَّهُمْ فِى دِينِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لَن تَمَسَّنَا ٱلنَّارُ إِلَّآ أَيَّامًا مَّعْدُودَٰتٍ‌ۖ وَغَرَّهُمْ فِى دِينِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ ۝٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ قَالُوْا لَنْ تَمَسَّنَا النَّارُ اِلَّا͏ٓ اَيَّامًا مَّعْدُوْدٰتٍࣕ وَغَرَّهُمْ فِيْ دِيْنِهِمْ مَّا كَانُوْا يَفْتَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: That is because they say, "Never will the Fire touch us except for [a few] numbered days," and [because] they were deluded in their religion by what they were inventing.
ayahs.transliteration: Thaalika bi-annahum qaaloo lan tamassanan naaru illaaa ayyaamam ma'doodaat(inw); wa-gharrahum fee deenihim maa kaanoo yaftaroon
ayahs.translationClear: That is because they said, “The Fire will not touch us except for a limited number of days.” They have been misled in their religion by the lies they fabricated.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جَمَعْنَـٰهُمْ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جَمَعْنَـٰهُمْ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ ۝٢٥
ayahs.textIndopak: فَكَيْفَ اِذَا جَمَعْنٰهُمْ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيْهِࣞ وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُوْنَ

words.translation: And will be paid in full

ayahs.translation: So how will it be when We assemble them for a Day about which there is no doubt? And each soul will be compensated [in full for] what it earned, and they will not be wronged.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa-kaifa ithaa jama'naahum li-Yawmil laa raiba fee wa-wuffiyat kullu nafsim maa kasabat wa-hum laa yuzlamoon
ayahs.translationClear: How about when We gather them for a Day in which there is no doubt, and each soul will be paid in full for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged?

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ مَـٰلِكَ ٱلْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِى ٱلْمُلْكَ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَنزِعُ ٱلْمُلْكَ مِمَّن تَشَآءُ وَتُعِزُّ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَن تَشَآءُ ۖ بِيَدِكَ ٱلْخَيْرُ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ مَـٰلِكَ ٱلْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِى ٱلْمُلْكَ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَنزِعُ ٱلْمُلْكَ مِمَّن تَشَآءُ وَتُعِزُّ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَن تَشَآءُ‌ۖ بِيَدِكَ ٱلْخَيْرُ‌ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ۝٢٦
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلِ اللّٰهُمَّ مٰلِكَ الْمُلْكِ تُو͏ٔ͏ْتِي الْمُلْكَ مَنْ تَشَا࢜ءُ وَتَنْزِعُ الْمُلْكَ مِمَّنْ تَشَا࢜ءُؗ وَتُعِزُّ مَنْ تَشَا࢜ءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَنْ تَشَا࢜ءُؕ بِيَدِكَ الْخَيْرُؕ اِنَّكَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
ayahs.translation: Say, "O Allāh, Owner of Sovereignty, You give sovereignty to whom You will and You take sovereignty away from whom You will. You honor whom You will and You humble whom You will. In Your hand[121] is [all] good. Indeed, You are over all things competent.
ayahs.transliteration: Qulil laahumma Maalikal Mulki tu'til mulka man tashaaa'u wa-tanzi'ul mulka mimman tashhaaa'u wa-tu'izzu man tashaaa'u wa-tuthillu man tashaaa'(u); biyadikal khair(u); innaka 'alaa kulli shai'in Qadeer
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “O Allah, Owner of Sovereignty. You grant sovereignty to whom You will, and You strip sovereignty from whom You will. You honor whom You will, and You humiliate whom You will. In Your hand is all goodness. You are Capable of all things.”

ayahs.textUthmani: تُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَتُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ ۖ وَتُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَتُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ ۖ وَتَرْزُقُ مَن تَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَتُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ‌ۖ وَتُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَتُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ‌ۖ وَتَرْزُقُ مَن تَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ ۝٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: تُوْلِجُ الَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَتُوْلِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي الَّيْلِؗ وَتُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَتُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّؗ وَتَرْزُقُ مَنْ تَشَا࢜ءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
ayahs.translation: You cause the night to enter the day, and You cause the day to enter the night; and You bring the living out of the dead, and You bring the dead out of the living. And You give provision to whom You will without account [i.e., limit or measure]."
ayahs.transliteration: Toolijul laila fin nahaari wa-toolijun nahaara fil lail(i); wa-tukhrijul haiya minal maiy-yiti wa-tukhrijul maiy-yita minal haiy(yi); wa-tarzuqu man tashaaa'u bighari hisaab
ayahs.translationClear: “You merge the night into the day, and You merge the day into the night; and You bring the living out of the dead, and You bring the dead out of the living; and You provide for whom You will without measure.”

ayahs.textUthmani: لَّا يَتَّخِذِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۖ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ فَلَيْسَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ فِى شَىْءٍ إِلَّآ أَن تَتَّقُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ تُقَىٰةً ۗ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسَهُۥ ۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَّا يَتَّخِذِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ‌ۖ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ فَلَيْسَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ فِى شَىْءٍ إِلَّآ أَن تَتَّقُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ تُقَىٰةً‌ۗ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسَهُۥ‌ۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ ۝٢٨
ayahs.textIndopak: لَا يَتَّخِذِ الْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ اَوْلِيَا࢜ءَ مِنْ دُوْنِ الْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَۚ وَمَنْ يَّفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ فَلَيْسَ مِنَ اللّٰهِ فِيْ شَيْءٍ اِلَّا͏ٓ اَنْ تَتَّقُوْا مِنْهُمْ تُقٰىةًؕ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ اللّٰهُ نَفْسَهٗؕ وَاِلَي اللّٰهِ الْمَصِيْرُ
ayahs.translation: Let not believers take disbelievers as allies [i.e., supporters or protectors] rather than believers. And whoever [of you] does that has nothing [i.e., no association] with Allāh, except when taking precaution against them in prudence.[122] And Allāh warns you of Himself, and to Allāh is the [final] destination.
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yatta-khithil mu'minoonal kaafireena awliyaaa'a min doonil mu'mineen(a); wa-maien yaf'al thaalika falaisa minal laahi fee shai'in illaaa an tat-taqoo minhum tuqaah:(tan) wa-yuhaththi-rukumul laahu nafsah:(u) wa-ilal laahil maseer

footnotes.122: When fearing harm from an enemy, the believer may pretend as long as his heart and intention are not affected.

ayahs.translationClear: Believers are not to take disbelievers for friends instead of believers. Whoever does that has nothing to do with Allah, unless it is to protect your own selves against them. Allah warns you to beware of Him. To Allah is the destiny.

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ إِن تُخْفُوا۟ مَا فِى صُدُورِكُمْ أَوْ تُبْدُوهُ يَعْلَمْهُ ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ إِن تُخْفُوا۟ مَا فِى صُدُورِكُمْ أَوْ تُبْدُوهُ يَعْلَمْهُ ٱللَّهُ‌ۗ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ‌ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ۝٢٩
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ اِنْ تُخْفُوْا مَا فِيْ صُدُوْرِكُمْ اَوْ تُبْدُوْهُ يَعْلَمْهُ اللّٰهُؕ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الْاَرْضِؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
ayahs.translation: Say, "Whether you conceal what is in your breasts or reveal it, Allāh knows it. And He knows that which is in the heavens and that which is on the earth. And Allāh is over all things competent.
ayahs.transliteration: Qul in tukhfoo maa fee sudoorikum aw tubdoohu ya'lamhul laah:(u) wa-ya'lamu maa fis samaawaati wa-maa fil ard:(i) wallaahu 'alaa kulli shai'in Qadeer
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “Whether you conceal what is in your hearts, or disclose it, Allah knows it.” He knows everything in the heavens and the earth. Allah is Powerful over everything.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَوْمَ تَجِدُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ مِنْ خَيْرٍ مُّحْضَرًا وَمَا عَمِلَتْ مِن سُوٓءٍ تَوَدُّ لَوْ أَنَّ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَهُۥٓ أَمَدًۢا بَعِيدًا ۗ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسَهُۥ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ رَءُوفٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ تَجِدُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ مِنْ خَيْرٍ مُّحْضَرًا وَمَا عَمِلَتْ مِن سُوٓءٍ تَوَدُّ لَوْ أَنَّ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَهُۥٓ أَمَدًۢا بَعِيدًا‌ۗ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسَهُۥ‌ۗ وَٱللَّهُ رَءُوفٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ ۝٣٠
ayahs.textIndopak: يَوْمَ تَجِدُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ مِنْ خَيْرٍ مُّحْضَرًاۚۖۛ وَّمَا عَمِلَتْ مِنْ سُوْ࢜ءٍۚۛ تَوَدُّ لَوْ اَنَّ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَهٗٓ اَمَدًاۢ بَعِيْدًاؕ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ اللّٰهُ نَفْسَهٗؕ وَاللّٰهُ رَءُوْفٌۢ بِالْعِبَادِ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: The Day every soul will find what it has done of good present [before it] and what it has done of evil, it will wish that between itself and that [evil] was a great distance. And Allāh warns you of Himself, and Allāh is Kind to [His] servants."
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma tajidu kullu nafsim maa 'amilat min khairim muh-dara(nw) wa-maa 'amilat min sooo'in tawaddu law anna baina-haa wa-baina-hooo amadam ba'eedaa:(an) wa-yuhaththi-rukumul laahu nafsah:(u) wallaahu ra'oofum bil'ibaad
ayahs.translationClear: On the Day when every soul finds all the good it has done presented. And as for the evil it has done, it will wish there were a great distance between them. Allah cautions you of Himself. Allah is Kind towards the servants.

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ إِن كُنتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱللَّهَ فَٱتَّبِعُونِى يُحْبِبْكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ إِن كُنتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱللَّهَ فَٱتَّبِعُونِى يُحْبِبْكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ‌ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ ۝٣١
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ تُحِبُّوْنَ اللّٰهَ فَاتَّبِعُوْنِيْ يُحْبِبْكُمُ اللّٰهُ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوْبَكُمْؕ وَاللّٰهُ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "If you should love Allāh, then follow me, [so] Allāh will love you and forgive you your sins. And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul in kuntum tuhib-boonal laaha fattabi'-oonee yuh`bib-kumul laahu wa-yaghfir lakum thunoobakum: wallaahu Ghafoorur Raheem
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “If you love Allah, then follow me, and Allah will love you, and will forgive you your sins.” Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلرَّسُولَ ۖ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلرَّسُولَ‌ۖ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ ۝٣٢
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ اَطِيْعُوا اللّٰهَ وَالرَّسُوْلَۚ فَاِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say, "Obey Allāh and the Messenger. But if you turn away - then indeed, Allāh does not like the disbelievers."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul atee'ul laaha war-Rasool(a); fa-in tawallaw fa-innal laaha laa yuhibbul kaafireen
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “Obey Allah and the Messenger.” But if they turn away—Allah does not love the faithless.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ وَنُوحًا وَءَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَءَالَ عِمْرَٰنَ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ وَنُوحًا وَءَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَءَالَ عِمْرَٰنَ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝٣٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ اصْطَفٰٓي اٰدَمَ وَنُوْحًا وَّاٰلَ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ وَاٰلَ عِمْرٰنَ عَلَي الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, Allāh chose Adam and Noah and the family of Abraham and the family of ʿImrān over the worlds -
ayahs.transliteration: ^Innal laahas tafaaa Aadama wa-Noohanw wa-Aala Ibraaheema wa-Aala Imraana 'alal 'aalameen
ayahs.translationClear: Allah chose Adam, and Noah, and the family of Abraham, and the family of Imran, over all mankind.

ayahs.textUthmani: ذُرِّيَّةًۢ بَعْضُهَا مِنۢ بَعْضٍ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ذُرِّيَّةًۢ بَعْضُهَا مِنۢ بَعْضٍ‌ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ ۝٣٤
ayahs.textIndopak: ذُرِّيَّةًۢ بَعْضُهَا مِنْۢ بَعْضٍؕ وَاللّٰهُ سَمِيْعٌ عَلِيْمٌ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Descendants, some of them from others. And Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
ayahs.transliteration: Thurriyyatam ba'duhaa mim ba'd:(inw) wallaahu Samee'un 'Aleem
ayahs.translationClear: Offspring one of the other. Allah is Hearer and Knower.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ‌ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ۝٣٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اِذْ قَالَتِ امْرَاَتُ عِمْرٰنَ رَبِّ اِنِّيْ نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِيْ بَطْنِيْ مُحَرَّرًا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّيْۚ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ
ayahs.translation: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing."
ayahs.transliteration: Ith qaalat im'ra-atu 'Imraana Rabbi innee nathartu laka maa fee batnee muhar-ra-ra(n) fataqabbal min(nee); innaka Antas Samee'ul 'Aleem
ayahs.translationClear: The wife of Imran said, “My Lord, I have vowed to You what is in my womb, dedicated, so accept from me; You are the Hearer and Knower.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَمَّا وَضَعَتْهَا قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَضَعْتُهَآ أُنثَىٰ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا وَضَعَتْ وَلَيْسَ ٱلذَّكَرُ كَٱلْأُنثَىٰ ۖ وَإِنِّى سَمَّيْتُهَا مَرْيَمَ وَإِنِّىٓ أُعِيذُهَا بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَمَّا وَضَعَتْهَا قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَضَعْتُهَآ أُنثَىٰ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا وَضَعَتْ وَلَيْسَ ٱلذَّكَرُ كَٱلْأُنثَىٰ‌ۖ وَإِنِّى سَمَّيْتُهَا مَرْيَمَ وَإِنِّىٓ أُعِيذُهَا بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ ۝٣٦
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَمَّا وَضَعَتْهَا قَالَتْ رَبِّ اِنِّيْ وَضَعْتُهَا͏ٓ اُنْثٰيؕ وَاللّٰهُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا وَضَعَتْؕ وَلَيْسَ الذَّكَرُ كَالْاُنْثٰيۚ وَاِنِّيْ سَمَّيْتُهَا مَرْيَمَ وَاِنِّيْٓ اُعِيْذُهَا بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ الشَّيْطٰنِ الرَّجِيْمِ
ayahs.translation: But when she delivered her, she said, "My Lord, I have delivered a female." And Allāh was most knowing of what she delivered, and the male is not like the female. "And I have named her Mary, and I seek refuge for her in You and [for] her descendants from Satan, the expelled [from the mercy of Allāh]."
ayahs.transliteration: Fa-lammaa wada'at-haa qaalat Rabbi innee wada'tuhaaa unsaa wallaahu a'lamu bimaa wada'at wa-laisaz thakaru kalunsaa; wa-innee sammai-tuhaa Maryama wa-innee u'eethuhaa bika wa-thurriy-yatahaa minash Shaitaanir Rajeem
ayahs.translationClear: And when she delivered her, she said, “My Lord, I have delivered a female,” and Allah was well aware of what she has delivered, “and the male is not like the female, and I have named her Mary, and have commended her and her descendants to Your protection, from Satan the outcast.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا‌ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًا‌ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا‌ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ‌ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ ۝٣٧
ayahs.textIndopak: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُوْلٍ حَسَنٍ وَّاَنۢ͏ْبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًاۙ وَّكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّاۚؕ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا الْمِحْرَابَۙ وَجَدَ عِنْدَهَا رِزْقًاۚ قَالَ يٰمَرْيَمُ اَنّٰي لَكِ هٰذَاؕ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
ayahs.translation: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account."
ayahs.transliteration: Fata-qabba-lahaa Rabbuhaa biqaboolin hasaninw wa-ambatahaa nabaatan hasananw wa-kaffalahaa Zakariyyaa; kullamaa dakhala 'alaihaa Zakariyyal Mihraaba wajada 'indahaa rizqa(n); qaala yaa-Maryamu annaa laki haathaa; qaalat huwa min 'indil laah(i); innal laaha yarzuqu maien yashaaa'u bighairi hisaab
ayahs.translationClear: Her Lord accepted her with a gracious reception, and brought her a beautiful upbringing, and entrusted her to the care of Zechariah. Whenever Zechariah entered upon her in the sanctuary, he found her with provision. He said, “O Mary, where did you get this from?” She said, “It is from Allah; Allah provides to whom He wills without reckoning.”

ayahs.textUthmani: هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهُۥ ۖ قَالَ رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهُۥ‌ۖ قَالَ رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً‌ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ ۝٣٨
ayahs.textIndopak: هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهٗۚ قَالَ رَبِّ هَبْ لِيْ مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةًۚ اِنَّكَ سَمِيْعُ الدُّعَا࢜ءِ
ayahs.translation: At that, Zechariah called upon his Lord, saying, "My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication."
ayahs.transliteration: Hunaaa-lika da'aa Zakariyyaa Rabbah(oo); qaala Rabbi hab lee mil ladunka thurriyyatan taiyiba(tan); innaka samee'ud du'aaa'
ayahs.translationClear: Thereupon Zechariah prayed to his Lord; he said, “My Lord, bestow on me good offspring from Your presence; You are the Hearer of Prayers.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَنَادَتْهُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُوَ قَآئِمٌ يُصَلِّى فِى ٱلْمِحْرَابِ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكَ بِيَحْيَىٰ مُصَدِّقًۢا بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَسَيِّدًا وَحَصُورًا وَنَبِيًّا مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَنَادَتْهُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُوَ قَآئِمٌ يُصَلِّى فِى ٱلْمِحْرَابِ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكَ بِيَحْيَىٰ مُصَدِّقًۢا بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَسَيِّدًا وَحَصُورًا وَنَبِيًّا مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ ۝٣٩
ayahs.textIndopak: فَنَادَتْهُ الْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةُ وَهُوَ قَا࢜ىِٕمٌ يُّصَلِّيْ فِي الْمِحْرَابِۙ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يُبَشِّرُكَ بِيَحْيٰي مُصَدِّقًاۢ بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَسَيِّدًا وَّحَصُوْرًا وَّنَبِيًّا مِّنَ الصّٰلِحِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: So the angels called him while he was standing in prayer in the chamber, "Indeed, Allāh gives you good tidings of John, confirming a word[123] from Allāh and [who will be] honorable, abstaining [from women], and a prophet from among the righteous."
ayahs.transliteration: Fanaadat-hul malaaa'ikatu wa-huwa qaaa'ee-muien yusallee fil Mihraabi annal laaha yubash-shiruka bi-Yahyaa musaddiqam bi-Kalimatim minal laah(i) wa-saiyidanw wa-hasooranw wa-Nabiyyam minas saaliheen

footnotes.123: Referring to the prophet Jesus (upon whom be peace) , who was conceived merely by a command from Allāh - the word "Be."

ayahs.translationClear: Then the angels called out to him, as he stood praying in the sanctuary: “Allah gives you good news of John; confirming a Word from Allah, and honorable, and moral, and a prophet; one of the upright.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌ‌ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۝٤٠
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ رَبِّ اَنّٰي يَكُوْنُ لِيْ غُلٰمٌ وَّقَدْ بَلَغَنِيَ الْكِبَرُ وَامْرَاَتِيْ عَاقِرٌؕ قَالَ كَذٰلِكَ اللّٰهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَا࢜ءُ
ayahs.translation: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" He [the angel] said, "Such is Allāh; He does what He wills."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala Rabbi annaa yakoonu lee ghulaamunw wa-qad bala-gha-niyal kibaru wam-raatee 'aaqir(un); qaala kathaa-likal laahu yaf'alu maa yashaaa'
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “My Lord, how will I have a son, when old age has overtaken me, and my wife is barren?” He said, “Even so, Allah does whatever He wills.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةً ۖ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَـٰثَةَ أَيَّامٍ إِلَّا رَمْزًا ۗ وَٱذْكُر رَّبَّكَ كَثِيرًا وَسَبِّحْ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِبْكَـٰرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةً‌ۖ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَـٰثَةَ أَيَّامٍ إِلَّا رَمْزًا‌ۗ وَٱذْكُر رَّبَّكَ كَثِيرًا وَسَبِّحْ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِبْكَـٰرِ ۝٤١
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ رَبِّ اجْعَلْ لِّيْٓ اٰيَةًؕ قَالَ اٰيَتُكَ اَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ النَّاسَ ثَلٰثَةَ اَيَّامٍ اِلَّا رَمْزًاؕ وَاذْكُرْ رَّبَّكَ كَثِيْرًا وَّسَبِّحْ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْاِبْكَارِ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: He said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not [be able to] speak to the people for three days except by gesture. And remember your Lord much and exalt [Him with praise] in the evening and the morning."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala Rabbij 'al leee Aayah(tan); qaala Aaayatuka allaa tukalliman naasa salaasata ayyaamin illa ramzaa:(an) wathkur Rabbaka kaseeranw wa-sabbih bil'ashiyyi wal-ib-kaar
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “My Lord, give me a sign.” He said, “Your sign is that you shall not speak to the people for three days, except by gestures. And remember your Lord much, and praise in the evening and the morning.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَٱصْطَفَىٰكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَآءِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَٱصْطَفَىٰكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَآءِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝٤٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِذْ قَالَتِ الْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةُ يٰمَرْيَمُ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ اصْطَفٰىكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَاصْطَفٰىكِ عَلٰي نِسَا࢜ءِ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And [mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allāh has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-ith qaa-latil malaaa'ikatu yaa-Maryamu innal laahas tafaaki wa-tah-haraki wastafaaki 'alaa nisaaa'il 'aalameen
ayahs.translationClear: The angels said, “O Mary, Allah has chosen you, and has purified you. He has chosen you over all the women of the world.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَـٰمَرْيَمُ ٱقْنُتِى لِرَبِّكِ وَٱسْجُدِى وَٱرْكَعِى مَعَ ٱلرَّٰكِعِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَـٰمَرْيَمُ ٱقْنُتِى لِرَبِّكِ وَٱسْجُدِى وَٱرْكَعِى مَعَ ٱلرَّٰكِعِينَ ۝٤٣
ayahs.textIndopak: يٰمَرْيَمُ اقْنُتِيْ لِرَبِّكِ وَاسْجُدِيْ وَارْكَعِيْ مَعَ الرّٰكِعِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: O Mary, be devoutly obedient to your Lord and prostrate and bow with those who bow [in prayer]."
ayahs.transliteration: Yaa-Maryamu uq-nutee li-Rabbiki wasjudee warka'ee ma'ar raaki'een
ayahs.translationClear: O Mary, be devoted to your Lord, and bow down, and kneel with those who kneel.”

ayahs.textUthmani: ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ ۚ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يُلْقُونَ أَقْلَـٰمَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ يَكْفُلُ مَرْيَمَ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ‌ۚ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يُلْقُونَ أَقْلَـٰمَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ يَكْفُلُ مَرْيَمَ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ ۝٤٤
ayahs.textIndopak: ذٰلِكَ مِنْ اَنۢ͏ْبَا࢜ءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوْحِيْهِ اِلَيْكَؕ وَمَا كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ اِذْ يُلْقُوْنَ اَقْلَامَهُمْ اَيُّهُمْ يَكْفُلُ مَرْيَمَࣕ وَمَا كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ اِذْ يَخْتَصِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal to you, [O Muḥammad]. And you were not with them when they cast their pens[124] as to which of them should be responsible for Mary. Nor were you with them when they disputed.
ayahs.transliteration: Thaalika min ambaaa'il ghaibi noo-heehi ilaik,(a) wa-maa kunta ladai`him ith yulqoona aq`laamahum ayyuhum yak-fulu Maryama wa-maa kunta ladai-him ith yakh-tasimoon
ayahs.translationClear: These are accounts from the Unseen, which We reveal to you. You were not with them when they cast their lots as to which of them would take charge of Mary; nor were you with them as they quarreled.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكِ بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنْهُ ٱسْمُهُ ٱلْمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ وَجِيهًا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكِ بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنْهُ ٱسْمُهُ ٱلْمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ وَجِيهًا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ ۝٤٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اِذْ قَالَتِ الْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةُ يٰمَرْيَمُ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُبَشِّرُكِ بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنْهُࣗۖ اسْمُهُ الْمَسِيْحُ عِيْسَي ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ وَجِيْهًا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ وَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: [And mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allāh gives you good tidings of a word[125] from Him, whose name will be the Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary - distinguished in this world and the Hereafter and among those brought near [to Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: Ith qaa-latil malaaa'ikatu yaa-Maryamu innal laaha yubash-shiruki bi-Kalimatim minhus muhul Maseehu 'Eesab nu Maryama wajeehan fid dunyaa wal-Aakhirati wa-minal muqar-rabeen
ayahs.translationClear: The angels said, “O Mary, Allah gives you good news of a Word from Him. His name is the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, well-esteemed in this world and the next, and one of the nearest.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيُكَلِّمُ ٱلنَّاسَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ وَكَهْلًا وَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيُكَلِّمُ ٱلنَّاسَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ وَكَهْلًا وَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ ۝٤٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيُكَلِّمُ النَّاسَ فِي الْمَهْدِ وَكَهْلًا وَّمِنَ الصّٰلِحِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: He will speak to the people in the cradle and in maturity and will be of the righteous."
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-yukallimun naasa fil mahdi wa-kahlanw wa-minas saaliheen
ayahs.translationClear: He will speak to the people from the crib, and in adulthood, and will be one of the righteous.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَتْ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى وَلَدٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ ٱللَّهُ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَتْ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى وَلَدٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌ‌ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ ٱللَّهُ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ‌ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ ۝٤٧
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَتْ رَبِّ اَنّٰي يَكُوْنُ لِيْ وَلَدٌ وَّلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِيْ بَشَرٌؕ قَالَ كَذٰلِكِ اللّٰهُ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَا࢜ءُؕ اِذَا قَضٰٓي اَمْرًا فَاِنَّمَا يَقُوْلُ لَهٗ كُنْ فَيَكُوْنُ
ayahs.translation: She said, "My Lord, how will I have a child when no man has touched me?" [The angel] said, "Such is Allāh; He creates what He wills. When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, 'Be,' and it is.
ayahs.transliteration: Qaalat Rabbi annaa yakoonu lee waladunw wa-lam yamsa-snee bashar(un); qaala kathaa-likil laahu yakhluqu maa yashaaa',(oo) ithaa qadaaa amran fa-innamaa yaqoolu lahoo kun fayakoon
ayahs.translationClear: She said, “My Lord, how can I have a child, when no man has touched me?” He said, “It will be so. Allah creates whatever He wills. To have anything done, He only says to it, ‘Be,’ and it is.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيُعَلِّمُهُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيُعَلِّمُهُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ ۝٤٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيُعَلِّمُهُ الْكِتٰبَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَالتَّوْرٰىةَ وَالْاِنْجِيْلَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And He will teach him writing and wisdom[126] and the Torah and the Gospel
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-yu'allimuhul Kitaaba wal-Hikmata wat-Tawraata wal-Injeel
ayahs.translationClear: And He will teach him the Scripture and wisdom, and the Torah and the Gospel.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَرَسُولًا إِلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَنِّى قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِـَٔايَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ أَنِّىٓ أَخْلُقُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطِّينِ كَهَيْـَٔةِ ٱلطَّيْرِ فَأَنفُخُ فِيهِ فَيَكُونُ طَيْرًۢا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَأُبْرِئُ ٱلْأَكْمَهَ وَٱلْأَبْرَصَ وَأُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا تَأْكُلُونَ وَمَا تَدَّخِرُونَ فِى بُيُوتِكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَرَسُولًا إِلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَنِّى قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِـَٔايَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ‌ۖ أَنِّىٓ أَخْلُقُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطِّينِ كَهَيْـَٔةِ ٱلطَّيْرِ فَأَنفُخُ فِيهِ فَيَكُونُ طَيْرًۢا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ‌ۖ وَأُبْرِئُ ٱلْأَكْمَهَ وَٱلْأَبْرَصَ وَأُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ‌ۖ وَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا تَأْكُلُونَ وَمَا تَدَّخِرُونَ فِى بُيُوتِكُمْ‌ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ ۝٤٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَرَسُوْلًا اِلٰي بَنِيْٓ اِسْرَا࢜ءِيْلَ࣢ۙ اَنِّيْ قَدْ جِي͏ٔ͏ْتُكُمْ بِاٰيَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْۚۙ اَنِّيْٓ اَخْلُقُ لَكُمْ مِّنَ الطِّيْنِ كَهَيْـٔ͏َةِ الطَّيْرِ فَاَنْفُخُ فِيْهِ فَيَكُوْنُ طَيْرًاۢ بِاِذْنِ اللّٰهِۚ وَاُبْرِي͏ٔ͏ُ الْاَكْمَهَ وَالْاَبْرَصَ وَاُحْيِ الْمَوْتٰي بِاِذْنِ اللّٰهِۚ وَاُنَبِّي͏ٔ͏ُكُمْ بِمَا تَاْكُلُوْنَ وَمَا تَدَّخِرُوْنَۙ فِيْ بُيُوْتِكُمْؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لَّكُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And [make him] a messenger to the Children of Israel, [who will say], 'Indeed I have come to you with a sign from your Lord in that I design for you from clay [that which is] like the form of a bird, then I breathe into it and it becomes a bird by permission of Allāh. And I cure the blind [from birth] and the leper, and I give life to the dead - by permission of Allāh. And I inform you of what you eat and what you store in your houses. Indeed in that is a sign for you, if you are believers.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-Rasoolan ilaa Baneee Israaa'eela annee qad ji'tukum bi-Aayatim mir Rabbikum; annee akhluqu lakum minat teeni kahai'atit tairi fa-anfukhu feehi fayakoonu tairam bi-ithnil laah(i); wa-ubri'ul akmaha wal-abrasa wa-uhyil mawtaa bi-ithnil laah(i); wa-unabbi'ukum bimaa taa`kuloona wa-maa tadda-khiroona fee buyootikum, inna fee thaalika la-Aayatal lakum in kuntum mu'mineen
ayahs.translationClear: A messenger to the Children of Israel: “I have come to you with a sign from your Lord. I make for you out of clay the figure of a bird; then I breathe into it, and it becomes a bird by Allah’s leave. And I heal the blind and the leprous, and I revive the dead, by Allah’s leave. And I inform you concerning what you eat, and what you store in your homes. In that is a sign for you, if you are believers.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَلِأُحِلَّ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى حُرِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَجِئْتُكُم بِـَٔايَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَلِأُحِلَّ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى حُرِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ‌ۚ وَجِئْتُكُم بِـَٔايَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ ۝٥٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنَ التَّوْرٰىةِ وَلِاُحِلَّ لَكُمْ بَعْضَ الَّذِيْ حُرِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَجِي͏ٔ͏ْتُكُمْ بِاٰيَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْࣞ فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَاَطِيْعُوْنِ

words.translation: and so that I make lawful

ayahs.translation: And [I have come] confirming what was before me of the Torah and to make lawful for you some of what was forbidden to you. And I have come to you with a sign from your Lord, so fear Allāh and obey me.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-musaddiqal limaa baina yadaiy-yaa minat Tawraati wa-li-uhilla lakum ba'dal lathee hurrima 'alaikum, wa-ji'tukum bi-Aayatim mir Rabbikum fattaqul laaha wa-atee'oon
ayahs.translationClear: “And verifying what lies before me of the Torah, and to make lawful for you some of what was forbidden to you. I have come to you with a sign from your Lord; so fear Allah, and obey me.”

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۗ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ‌ۗ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ ۝٥١
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ رَبِّيْ وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوْهُؕ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيْمٌ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is the straight path.'"
ayahs.transliteration: Innal laaha Rabbee wa-Rabbukum fa'budooh:(u) haathaa Siraatum Mustaqeem
ayahs.translationClear: “Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path.”

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ فَلَمَّآ أَحَسَّ عِيسَىٰ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْكُفْرَ قَالَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَٱشْهَدْ بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ فَلَمَّآ أَحَسَّ عِيسَىٰ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْكُفْرَ قَالَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ‌ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَٱشْهَدْ بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ ۝٥٢
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَمَّا͏ٓ اَحَسَّ عِيْسٰي مِنْهُمُ الْكُفْرَ قَالَ مَنْ اَنْصَارِيْٓ اِلَي اللّٰهِؕ قَالَ الْحَوَارِيُّوْنَ نَحْنُ اَنْصَارُ اللّٰهِۚ اٰمَنَّا بِاللّٰهِۚ وَاشْهَدْ بِاَنَّا مُسْلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But when Jesus felt [persistence in] disbelief from them, he said, "Who are my supporters for [the cause of] Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters for Allāh. We have believed in Allāh and testify that we are Muslims [submitting to Him].
ayahs.transliteration: ^Fa-lammaaa ahassa 'Eesaa min-humul kufra qaala man ansaaree ilal laah(i); qaalal Hawaariy-yoona nahnu ansaarul laahi aamannaa billaahi wash-had bi-annaa muslimoon
ayahs.translationClear: When Jesus sensed disbelief on their part, he said, “Who are my allies towards Allah?” The disciples said, “We are Allah’s allies; we have believed in Allah, and bear witness that we submit.”

ayahs.textUthmani: رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا بِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ وَٱتَّبَعْنَا ٱلرَّسُولَ فَٱكْتُبْنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا بِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ وَٱتَّبَعْنَا ٱلرَّسُولَ فَٱكْتُبْنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ ۝٥٣
ayahs.textIndopak: رَبَّنَا͏ٓ اٰمَنَّا بِمَا͏ٓ اَنْزَلْتَ وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُوْلَ فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشّٰهِدِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Our Lord, we have believed in what You revealed and have followed the messenger [i.e., Jesus], so register us among the witnesses [to truth]."
ayahs.transliteration: Rabbanaaa aamannaa bimaaa anzalta wattaba'nar Rasoola faktubnaa ma'ash shaahideen
ayahs.translationClear: “Our Lord, we have believed in what You have revealed, and we have followed the Messenger, so count us among the witnesses.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَكَرُوا۟ وَمَكَرَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرُ ٱلْمَـٰكِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَكَرُوا۟ وَمَكَرَ ٱللَّهُ‌ۖ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرُ ٱلْمَـٰكِرِينَ ۝٥٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَكَرُوْا وَمَكَرَ اللّٰهُؕ وَاللّٰهُ خَيْرُ الْمٰكِرِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And they [i.e., the disbelievers] planned, but Allāh planned. And Allāh is the best of planners.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-makaroo wa-makaral laah(u); wallaahu khairul maakireen
ayahs.translationClear: They planned, and Allah planned; but Allah is the Best of planners.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِذْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ يَـٰعِيسَىٰٓ إِنِّى مُتَوَفِّيكَ وَرَافِعُكَ إِلَىَّ وَمُطَهِّرُكَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَجَاعِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوكَ فَوْقَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ فِيمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِذْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ يَـٰعِيسَىٰٓ إِنِّى مُتَوَفِّيكَ وَرَافِعُكَ إِلَىَّ وَمُطَهِّرُكَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَجَاعِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوكَ فَوْقَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ‌ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ فِيمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ ۝٥٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اِذْ قَالَ اللّٰهُ يٰعِيْسٰٓي اِنِّيْ مُتَوَفِّيْكَ وَرَافِعُكَ اِلَيَّ وَمُطَهِّرُكَ مِنَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَجَاعِلُ الَّذِيْنَ اتَّبَعُوْكَ فَوْقَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْٓا اِلٰي يَوْمِ الْقِيٰمَةِۚ ثُمَّ اِلَيَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَاَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ فِيْمَا كُنْتُمْ فِيْهِ تَخْتَلِفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: [Mention] when Allāh said, "O Jesus, indeed I will take you and raise you to Myself and purify [i.e., free] you from those who disbelieve and make those who follow you [in submission to Allāh alone] superior to those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection. Then to Me is your return, and I will judge between you concerning that in which you used to differ.
ayahs.transliteration: Ith qaalal laahu yaa-'Eesaaa innee mutawaffeeka wa-raafi'uka ilaiya wa-mutah-hiruka minal latheena kafaroo wa-jaa'ilul latheenat taba-ooka fawqal latheena kafarooo ilaa Yawmil Qiyaama(ti); summa ilaiya marji'ukum fa-ahkumu bainakum feemaa kuntum feehi takh-taliifoon
ayahs.translationClear: Allah said, “O Jesus, I am terminating your life, and raising you to Me, and clearing you of those who disbelieve. And I will make those who follow you superior to those who disbelieve, until the Day of Resurrection. Then to Me is your return; then I will judge between you regarding what you were disputing.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَأُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَأُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ ۝٥٦
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا فَاُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيْدًا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِؗ وَمَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ نّٰصِرِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And as for those who disbelieved, I will punish them with a severe punishment in this world and the Hereafter, and they will have no helpers."
ayahs.transliteration: Fa-ammal latheena kafaroo fa-u'ath-thibuhum 'athaaban shadeedan fid dunyaa wal-Aakhira(ti) wa-maa lahum min naasireen
ayahs.translationClear: As for those who disbelieve, I will punish them with a severe punishment, in this world and the next, and they will have no helpers.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَيُوَفِّيهِمْ أُجُورَهُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَيُوَفِّيهِمْ أُجُورَهُمْ‌ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ ۝٥٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَيُوَفِّيْهِمْ اُجُوْرَهُمْؕ وَاللّٰهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ

words.translation: then He will grant them in full

ayahs.translation: But as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, He will give them in full their rewards, and Allāh does not like the wrongdoers.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-ammal latheena aamanoo wa-'amilus saalihaati fa-yuwaf-feehim ujoorahum: wallaahu laa yuhibbuz zaalimeen
ayahs.translationClear: And as for those who believe and do good works, He will give them their rewards in full. Allah does not love the unjust.”

ayahs.textUthmani: ذَٰلِكَ نَتْلُوهُ عَلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ وَٱلذِّكْرِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ذَٰلِكَ نَتْلُوهُ عَلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ وَٱلذِّكْرِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ ۝٥٨
ayahs.textIndopak: ذٰلِكَ نَتْلُوْهُ عَلَيْكَ مِنَ الْاٰيٰتِ وَالذِّكْرِ الْحَكِيْمِ
ayahs.translation: This is what We recite to you, [O Muḥammad], of [Our] verses and the precise [and wise] message [i.e., the Qur’ān].
ayahs.transliteration: Thaalika natloohu 'alaika minal Aayaati wa-Thikril Hakeem
ayahs.translationClear: This is what We recite to you of the Verses and the Wise Reminder.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيسَىٰ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ ءَادَمَ ۖ خَلَقَهُۥ مِن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيسَىٰ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ ءَادَمَ‌ۖ خَلَقَهُۥ مِن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ ۝٥٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيْسٰي عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ كَمَثَلِ اٰدَمَؕ خَلَقَهٗ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهٗ كُنْ فَيَكُوْنُ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the example of Jesus to Allāh[127] is like that of Adam. He created him from dust; then He said to him, "Be," and he was.
ayahs.transliteration: Inna masala 'Eesaa 'indal laahi kamasali Aadam(a); khala-qahoo min turaabin summa qaala lahoo kun fayakoon

footnotes.127: i.e., regarding His creation of him.

ayahs.translationClear: The likeness of Jesus in Allah’s sight is that of Adam: He created him from dust, then said to him, “Be,” and he was.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْمُمْتَرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْمُمْتَرِينَ ۝٦٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلْحَقُّ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُنْ مِّنَ الْمُمْتَرِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: The truth is from your Lord, so do not be among the doubters.
ayahs.transliteration: Alhaqqu mir Rabbika falaa takum minal mumtareen
ayahs.translationClear: The truth is from your Lord, so do not be of those who doubt.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَمَنْ حَآجَّكَ فِيهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ فَقُلْ تَعَالَوْا۟ نَدْعُ أَبْنَآءَنَا وَأَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَنِسَآءَنَا وَنِسَآءَكُمْ وَأَنفُسَنَا وَأَنفُسَكُمْ ثُمَّ نَبْتَهِلْ فَنَجْعَل لَّعْنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَمَنْ حَآجَّكَ فِيهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ فَقُلْ تَعَالَوْا۟ نَدْعُ أَبْنَآءَنَا وَأَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَنِسَآءَنَا وَنِسَآءَكُمْ وَأَنفُسَنَا وَأَنفُسَكُمْ ثُمَّ نَبْتَهِلْ فَنَجْعَل لَّعْنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ ۝٦١
ayahs.textIndopak: فَمَنْ حَا࢜جَّكَ فِيْهِ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَا࢜ءَكَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ فَقُلْ تَعَالَوْا نَدْعُ اَبْنَا࢜ءَنَا وَاَبْنَا࢜ءَكُمْ وَنِسَا࢜ءَنَا وَنِسَا࢜ءَكُمْ وَاَنْفُسَنَا وَاَنْفُسَكُمْࣞ ثُمَّ نَبْتَهِلْ فَنَجْعَلْ لَّعْنَتَ اللّٰهِ عَلَي الْكٰذِبِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then whoever argues with you about it after [this] knowledge has come to you - say, "Come, let us call our sons and your sons, our women and your women, ourselves and yourselves, then supplicate earnestly [together] and invoke the curse of Allāh upon the liars [among us]."
ayahs.transliteration: Faman haaaj-jaka feehi mim ba'di maa jaaa'aka minal 'ilmi faqul ta'aalaw nad'u abnaaa'anaa wa-abnaaa'akum wa-nisaaa'anaa wa-nisaaa'akum wa-anfusanaa wa-anfusakum summa nabtahil fanaj'al la'natal laahi 'alal kaathibeen
ayahs.translationClear: And if anyone disputes with you about him, after the knowledge that has come to you, say, “Come, let us call our children and your children, and our women and your women, and ourselves and yourselves, and let us invoke Allah’s curse on the liars.”

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْقَصَصُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۚ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْقَصَصُ ٱلْحَقُّ‌ۚ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ‌ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ۝٦٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ هٰذَا لَهُوَ الْقَصَصُ الْحَقُّۚ وَمَا مِنْ اِلٰهٍ اِلَّا اللّٰهُؕ وَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, this is the true narration. And there is no deity except Allāh. And indeed, Allāh is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa haathaa lahuwal qasasul haqq,(u) wa-maa min ilaahin illal laah,(u) wa-innal laahaa la-Huwal 'Azeezul Hakeem
ayahs.translationClear: This is the narrative of truth: there is no god but Allah. Allah is the Mighty, the Wise.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ ۝٦٣
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلِيْمٌۢ بِالْمُفْسِدِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: But if they turn away, then indeed - Allāh is Knowing of the corrupters.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa-in tawallau fa-innal laaha 'aleemun bil-mufsideen
ayahs.translationClear: But if they turn away—Allah knows the corrupt.

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ تَعَالَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ كَلِمَةٍ سَوَآءٍۭ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ أَلَّا نَعْبُدَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ وَلَا نُشْرِكَ بِهِۦ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُنَا بَعْضًا أَرْبَابًا مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُولُوا۟ ٱشْهَدُوا۟ بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ تَعَالَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ كَلِمَةٍ سَوَآءٍۭ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ أَلَّا نَعْبُدَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ وَلَا نُشْرِكَ بِهِۦ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُنَا بَعْضًا أَرْبَابًا مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ‌ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُولُوا۟ ٱشْهَدُوا۟ بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ ۝٦٤
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ يٰٓاَهْلَ الْكِتٰبِ تَعَالَوْا اِلٰي كَلِمَةٍ سَوَا࢜ءٍۭ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ اَلَّا نَعْبُدَ اِلَّا اللّٰهَ وَلَا نُشْرِكَ بِهٖ شَيْـٔ͏ًا وَّلَا يَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُنَا بَعْضًا اَرْبَابًا مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِؕ فَاِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقُوْلُوا اشْهَدُوْا بِاَنَّا مُسْلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say, "O People of the Scripture, come to a word that is equitable between us and you - that we will not worship except Allāh and not associate anything with Him and not take one another as lords instead of Allāh."[128] But if they turn away, then say, "Bear witness that we are Muslims [submitting to Him]."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul yaa-Ahlal Kitaabi ta'aalau ilaa Kalimatin sawaaa'im bainanaa wa-bainakum allaa na'buda illal laaha wa-laa nushrika bihee shai'anw wa-laa yat-takhitha ba'dunaa ba'dan arbaabam min doonil laah,(i) fa-in tawallau faqoo-lush hadoo bi-annaa muslimoon

footnotes.128: By obeying another in disobedience to Allāh.

ayahs.translationClear: Say, “O People of the Book, come to terms common between us and you: that we worship none but Allah, and that we associate nothing with Him, and that none of us takes others as lords besides Allah.” And if they turn away, say, “Bear witness that we have submitted.”

ayahs.textUthmani: يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لِمَ تُحَآجُّونَ فِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَتِ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةُ وَٱلْإِنجِيلُ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦٓ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لِمَ تُحَآجُّونَ فِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَتِ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةُ وَٱلْإِنجِيلُ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦٓ‌ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ ۝٦٥
ayahs.textIndopak: يٰٓاَهْلَ الْكِتٰبِ لِمَ تُحَا࢜جُّوْنَ فِيْٓ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ وَمَا͏ٓ اُنْزِلَتِ التَّوْرٰىةُ وَالْاِنْجِيْلُ اِلَّا مِنْۢ بَعْدِهٖؕ اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: O People of the Scripture, why do you argue about Abraham while the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed until after him? Then will you not reason?
ayahs.transliteration: Yaaa-Ahlal Kitaabi limaa tuhaaaj-joona feee Ibraaheema wa-maaa unzilatit Tawraatu wal-Injeelu illaa mim ba'dih,(ee) afala ta'qiloon
ayahs.translationClear: O People of the Book! Why do you argue about Abraham, when the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed until after him? Will you not reason?

ayahs.textUthmani: هَـٰٓأَنتُمْ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ حَـٰجَجْتُمْ فِيمَا لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ فَلِمَ تُحَآجُّونَ فِيمَا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: هَـٰٓأَنتُمْ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ حَـٰجَجْتُمْ فِيمَا لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ فَلِمَ تُحَآجُّونَ فِيمَا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ‌ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ ۝٦٦
ayahs.textIndopak: هٰٓاَنْتُمْ هٰٓو͏ٔ͏ُلَا࢜ءِ حَاجَجْتُمْ فِيْمَا لَكُمْ بِهٖ عِلْمٌ فَلِمَ تُحَا࢜جُّوْنَ فِيْمَا لَيْسَ لَكُمْ بِهٖ عِلْمٌؕ وَاللّٰهُ يَعْلَمُ وَاَنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Here you are - those who have argued about that of which you have [some] knowledge, but why do you argue about that of which you have no knowledge? And Allāh knows, while you know not.
ayahs.transliteration: Haaa-antum haaa'ulaaa'i haa-jajtum feemaa lakum bihee 'ilmun falima tuhaaaj-joonaa feemaa laisa lakum bihee 'ilm,(un) wal-laahu ya'lamu wa-antum laa ta'lamoon
ayahs.translationClear: Here you are—you argue about things you know, but why do you argue about things you do not know? Allah knows, and you do not know.

ayahs.textUthmani: مَا كَانَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ يَهُودِيًّا وَلَا نَصْرَانِيًّا وَلَـٰكِن كَانَ حَنِيفًا مُّسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَا كَانَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ يَهُودِيًّا وَلَا نَصْرَانِيًّا وَلَـٰكِن كَانَ حَنِيفًا مُّسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ ۝٦٧
ayahs.textIndopak: مَا كَانَ اِبْرٰهِيْمُ يَهُوْدِيًّا وَّلَا نَصْرَانِيًّا وَّلٰكِنْ كَانَ حَنِيْفًا مُّسْلِمًاؕ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Abraham was neither a Jew nor a Christian, but he was one inclining toward truth, a Muslim [submitting to Allāh]. And he was not of the polytheists.[129]
ayahs.transliteration: Maa kaana Ibraaheemu Yahoodiy-yanw wa-laa Nasraa-niyyanw wa-laakin kaana Haneefam Muslima(nw) wa-maa kaana minal mushrikeen

footnotes.129: Those who associate others with Allāh.

ayahs.translationClear: Abraham was neither a Jew nor a Christian, but he was a Monotheist, a Muslim. And he was not of the polytheists.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ أَوْلَى ٱلنَّاسِ بِإِبْرَٰهِيمَ لَلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ وَهَـٰذَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ أَوْلَى ٱلنَّاسِ بِإِبْرَٰهِيمَ لَلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ وَهَـٰذَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟‌ۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۝٦٨
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ اَوْلَي النَّاسِ بِاِبْرٰهِيْمَ لَلَّذِيْنَ اتَّبَعُوْهُ وَهٰذَا النَّبِيُّ وَالَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْاؕ وَاللّٰهُ وَلِيُّ الْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the most worthy of Abraham among the people are those who followed him [in submission to Allāh] and this prophet [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] and those who believe [in his message]. And Allāh is the Ally[130] of the believers.
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa awlan naasi bi-Ibraaheema lallatheenat taba-'oohu wa-haathan nabiyyu wallatheena aamanoo: wallaahu waliyyul mu'mineen
ayahs.translationClear: The people most deserving of Abraham are those who followed him, and this prophet, and those who believe. Allah is the Guardian of the believers.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَدَّت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَوْ يُضِلُّونَكُمْ وَمَا يُضِلُّونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَدَّت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَوْ يُضِلُّونَكُمْ وَمَا يُضِلُّونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ ۝٦٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَدَّتْ طَّا࢜ىِٕفَةٌ مِّنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتٰبِ لَوْ يُضِلُّوْنَكُمْؕ وَمَا يُضِلُّوْنَ اِلَّا͏ٓ اَنْفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: A faction of the People of the Scripture wish they could mislead you. But they do not mislead except themselves, and they perceive [it] not.
ayahs.transliteration: Waddat taaa'ifatum min Ahlil Kitaabi lau yudil-loonakum wa-maa yudilloona illaaa anfusa-hum wa-maa yash'uroon
ayahs.translationClear: A party of the People of the Book would love to lead you astray, but they only lead themselves astray, and they do not realize it.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لِمَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَنتُمْ تَشْهَدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لِمَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَنتُمْ تَشْهَدُونَ ۝٧٠
ayahs.textIndopak: يٰٓاَهْلَ الْكِتٰبِ لِمَ تَكْفُرُوْنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَاَنْتُمْ تَشْهَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: O People of the Scripture, why do you disbelieve in the verses of Allāh[131] while you witness [to their truth]?
ayahs.transliteration: Yaaa-Ahlal Kitaabi lima takfuroona bi-Aayaatil laahi wan-antum tashadoon
ayahs.translationClear: O People of the Book! Why do you reject the revelations of Allah, even as you witness?

ayahs.textUthmani: يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لِمَ تَلْبِسُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ بِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ وَتَكْتُمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لِمَ تَلْبِسُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ بِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ وَتَكْتُمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ ۝٧١
ayahs.textIndopak: يٰٓاَهْلَ الْكِتٰبِ لِمَ تَلْبِسُوْنَ الْحَقَّ بِالْبَاطِلِ وَتَكْتُمُوْنَ الْحَقَّ وَاَنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: O People of the Scripture, why do you mix [i.e., confuse] the truth with falsehood and conceal the truth while you know [it]?
ayahs.transliteration: Yaaa-Ahalal Kitaabi lima talbisoonal haqqa bilbaatili wa-taktumoonal haqqa wa-antum ta'lamoon
ayahs.translationClear: O People of the Book! Why do you confound the truth with falsehood, and knowingly conceal the truth?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالَت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَجْهَ ٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱكْفُرُوٓا۟ ءَاخِرَهُۥ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالَت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَجْهَ ٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱكْفُرُوٓا۟ ءَاخِرَهُۥ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ ۝٧٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالَتْ طَّا࢜ىِٕفَةٌ مِّنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتٰبِ اٰمِنُوْا بِالَّذِيْٓ اُنْزِلَ عَلَي الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَجْهَ النَّهَارِ وَاكْفُرُوْٓا اٰخِرَهٗ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُوْنَ ۚۖ
ayahs.translation: And a faction of the People of the Scripture say [to each other], "Believe in that which was revealed to the believers at the beginning of the day and reject it at its end that perhaps they will return [i.e., abandon their religion],
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-qaalat taaa'ifatum min Ahlil Kitaabi aaminoo billatheee unzila 'alal latheena aamanoo waj-han nahaari wak-furooo aakhirahoo la'alla-hum yarji'oon
ayahs.translationClear: Some of the People of the Book say, “Believe in what was revealed to the believers at the beginning of the day, and reject it at its end, so that they may return.”
